mapper.sql: (6371 * ACOS(LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1, COS(RADIANS(#{originLat})) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(hi.latitude AS DECIMAL(12, 8)))) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(hi.longitude AS DECIMAL(12, 8))) - RADIANS(#{originLng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{originLat})) * SIN(RADIANS(CAST(hi.latitude AS DECIMAL(12, 8)))) ))))

SELECT CAST(hd.no AS CHAR) AS id, hi.apt_seq, hi.apt_nm AS apt_name, hi.sgg_cd AS lawd_code, CONCAT(hi.sgg_cd, hi.umd_cd) AS legal_dong_code, hi.umd_nm AS legal_dong_name, TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(CONCAT(COALESCE(dc.sido_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(dc.gugun_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(hi.umd_nm, ''), ' ', COALESCE(hi.jibun, '')), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS address, CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(hd.deal_amount, '0'), ',', '') AS UNSIGNED) AS amount, hd.exclu_use_ar AS area, CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(hd.floor, '0'), ',', '') AS SIGNED) AS floor, hi.build_year AS built_year, CASE WHEN hd.deal_year > 0 AND hd.deal_month > 0 AND hd.deal_day > 0 THEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(hd.deal_year, LPAD(hd.deal_month, 2, '0'), LPAD(hd.deal_day, 2, '0')), '%Y%m%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS deal_date, CAST(hi.latitude AS DECIMAL(12, 8)) AS latitude, CAST(hi.longitude AS DECIMAL(12, 8)) AS longitude, AS distance_km FROM housedeals hd JOIN houseinfos hi ON hd.apt_seq = hi.apt_seq LEFT JOIN dongcodes dc ON dc.dong_code = CONCAT(hi.sgg_cd, hi.umd_cd) WHERE hi.latitude IS NOT NULL AND hi.longitude IS NOT NULL AND hi.latitude != '' AND hi.longitude != ''
